security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Review GitLab merge requests with a local, read-only AI agent
bundle.longDescription: Peerlens lists your GitLab merge requests and reviews them with Claude Code or Codex running locally in read-only mode. It talks to GitLab only through glab with GET requests. Nothing is applied, committed or posted.
